override.title: Good news
override.headline: Share your good news.
notes: 12:00 to 12:20 PM, over lunch. One piece of good news each, personal or professional.
Confirm agreement on how the group will work. Invite difficult facts and constructive disagreement.
1:20 to 1:50 PM. Thirty minutes on how to use your plan, then the plan presentations.
Start with how the business makes money today. The plan comes next.
Watch one widget travel: each function adds days, and the counter shows time to cash. At the end the widget becomes money in the bank.
Where we are: the top of the cascade. The numbers start at the 3HAG.
One page, four blocks. Check your own 3HAG against it.
Same subscription business as the KFFM example. The five widgets are the five hand-offs on that map, counted for Year 3.
Every number has an owner, the same owner it will have in the 1HAG and QHAG.
The numbers hang together: about 4,000 subscribers at roughly $250 a month is $12 million, and 4,000 subscribers paying monthly is 48,000 collected payments.
The statement has no numbers. Each capability strengthens one function on the map. Known for is what customers would say.
Same page as the 3HAG, one year out. Every number keeps its owner.
The widget owners come straight from the KFFM: Chris owns the leads Marketing hands on, Andrew new subscriptions, Jen activations, Allison collected payments.
Then 3 to 5 company priorities, each with one owner, a done-by date and a measure of success.
3:55 to 4:00 PM. Go around the table. Everyone answers. Leave for Patois at 4:00 PM.
